detail.longDescription: New on :foojay: Foojay Today: Michael Gasche explains why he built jip, a lightweight, pip-inspired dependency manager and runner for Java. Clone a project, run "jip run", and skip the Maven or Gradle setup. It ships as a single binary, uses a slim jip.toml file, and is written in Rust. It doesn't aim to replace Maven or Gradle for every project, but it makes trying out code much more direct. https:// foojay.io/today/jip/ # Java # OpenSource # DependencyManagement
